programs.title: The Story of Cabrillo National Monument
programs.about: Behind every landmark at Cabrillo National Monument is a story. Join a ranger for a 30-minute guided walk introducing the people, places, and events that shaped Cabrillo National Monument. From Juan Rodríguez Cabrillo's 1542 expedition and the history of the Old Point Loma Lighthouse to the creation and growth of the monument itself, discover how this remarkable landscape became the park visitors

programs.title: Guided Walking Tour of Cabrillo
programs.about: Join a park volunteer for a one-hour walking tour of Cabrillo National Monument including the Cabrillo Statue and the Old Point Loma Lighthouse at 11 a.m. and 1 p.m. This program is suitable for all ages. No reservations required. Meet in front of the Visitor Center and keep in mind that the walk includes a hill up to the lighthouse.

programs.title: Open Military Bunker
programs.about: If conditions permit, volunteers will bring the coastal defenses of Point Loma to life. These are your only chances to tour the bunkers on Point Loma. Don't miss this amazing opportunity to learn more about the soldiers stationed at Fort Rosecrans during WWII and see the weapons and instruments that protected our coast during the tumultuous war years. programs.title: Guided Bird Watching
programs.where: Tidepool parking lot one of the coastal area.
programs.about: Cabrillo National Monument is a hotspot for both resident and migrating birds as part of the Pacific Flyway, a central migration corridor used by billions of birds each year. Its unique ecology and position along the coast make Cabrillo an ideal place to observe terrestrial and coastal bird species. Join park staff for a one-mile bird watching hike along the coastal trail. All ages and experience

programs.title: Open Tower Day
programs.about: Imagine yourself as the first keeper when you make your way to the top of the lighthouse in celebration of the anniversary of the first time the light was lit! On Open Tower Days, you can experience the lighthouse with a half-hour guided tour between 10:00am - 3:30pm. programs.where: Cabrillo
programs.about: Cabrillo will be open normal operating hours on New Year's Day.

programs.title: Guided Hikes on the Islands
programs.where: Park Islands
programs.about: On days that the concessionaire boats run to the islands, guided hikes may be offered by national park rangers, volunteers, or concessionaire naturalists. If they are not available to lead hikes, self-guided interpretive trail booklets are available. programs.where:
Stovepipe Wells Resort
Death Valley National Park
51880 Highway 190
Death Valley, CA 92328
programs.about: The Death Valley '49ers Encampment is a multi-day event that focuses on Death Valley and Western history, lore, music, and art. The Encampment includes a vendor/exhibition fair, guest speakers about history and geology, Western music performances, cowboy poetry, star gazing, etc.

programs.title: Timbisha Shoshone Tribe presentation of "We Are Still Here" documentary, followed by Q&A
programs.where: Stovepipe Wells Resort
programs.about: We Are Still Here is a recent documentary film about the Timbisha Shoshone Tribe. This viewing will be followed by questions and answers with Jimmy-John Thompson (a tribal council member) and Mandi Campbell (former Tribal Historic Preservation Officer). This event is a portion of the events celebrating the 100th anniversary of Stovepipe Wells Resort.

programs.title: Star Party
programs.where: Fiddlers' Campground
programs.about: Join Death Valley Rangers and the Las Vegas Astronomical Society for a Star Party ! Drop by anytime 7pm-10pm to explore the night sky by telescope. To help you eyes adjust to the night sky, please limit white light use at event. Parking is located at the Furnace Creek Visitor Center with a short walk to Fiddlers' Campgound.

programs.title: Solar Scope Viewing
programs.about: Join the Las Vegas Astronomical Society to look through solar scopes and learn more about our sun.

programs.title: Star Party
programs.where: Fiddlers' Campground
programs.about: Join Death Valley Rangers and the Las Vegas Astronomical Society for a Star Party ! Drop by anytime 6pm-9pm to explore the night sky by telescope. To help you eyes adjust to the night sky, please limit white light use at event. Parking is located at the Furnace Creek Visitor Center with a short walk to Fiddlers' Campgound.

programs.title: Climber Coffee
programs.where: The program is set up in between the intersection Rock parking area and Hidden Valley Campground.
programs.about: Enjoy some from free coffee, tea, or hot coco while chatting with fellow climbers about best climbing routes, shady or sunny crags, or learn about the park's resources. Meet the Climber Stewards, play some trivia, and meet up with your friends and community. Bring your own mug!

programs.title: Prewett Point Guided Hike
programs.where: Join us at the West Visitor Contact Station near the Prewett Point Trailhead on the west side of the park.
programs.about: Join a ranger on a hike and learn some of Pinnacles' fascinating resources that are protected in the park.

programs.title: Ranger's Choice
programs.where: Join us at the Bear Gulch Nature Center on the east side of the park.
programs.about: Learn about Pinnacles' amazing resources with a ranger as they discuss topics varying from wildlife to geology, to history.
